# EditorView: a text editor

<!-- Generated by dist/sdk/gen-widget-docs.py from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

The editor component (the engine is `iyakki-edit`, re-used through the SDK).

## `editorview`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/editorview.rs`)

`EditorView`: the IYAKKI text editor as a component an SDK app places in its layout (docs/development/UI-SDK.md, "Embedding the editor",
F-SDK-104). The engine is `iyakki-edit` (the buffer with undo, the highlighter, the diff and the proposal reader that the EDIT tile and the
chat's edit mode use); the view owns what is on screen: the gutter, the highlighted lines, the cursor and selection, the toolbar and the
review of what the assistant proposes. It draws through [`Canvas`], so it works in the shell, in a browser or client and as a WASM tile.

What the app does:
```text
open a file:   ed.load("notes/todo.md", &text)                     (the app got the text from the files port)
event(Action): if ed.owns(a) { ed.action(a) }   event(Key): ed.key(k)   event(Text): ed.text(t)   event(Wheel): ed.wheel(n)
view:          ed.draw(c, th, &metrics, rect)
saving:        if let Some((path, text)) = ed.take_save() { ... the app writes it through its own port ... ; ed.mark_saved() }
the assistant: items = ed.context()                          (the document and the selection, as context for the assistant)
ed.offer_reply(&assistant_reply)               (a reply with SEARCH/REPLACE blocks becomes a proposal to review)
```
The editor never writes a file and never calls the assistant: the app does both through the ports it was handed. An assistant's change is
never applied by itself: the view shows each changed place as a hunk the person accepts or rejects, then applies the accepted ones as one
undoable edit.

### const `MAX_HUNKS`

Hunks listed and text rows drawn at most (a hunk has the action `base + 8 + i`, a text row `base + 40 + i`).

```rust
pub const MAX_HUNKS: u32 = 32
```

### const `MAX_ROWS`

```rust
pub const MAX_ROWS: u32 = 120
```

### const `ACTIONS`

How many action numbers an editor view uses, from the base the app gave it.

```rust
pub const ACTIONS: u32 = A_LINE0 + MAX_ROWS
```

What the assistant is given about the document: the same shape as the assistant component's context items, so the app passes them on.

pub struct EditorContext

### struct `EditorView`

```rust
pub struct EditorView
```

Public fields:

- `pub path: String`
- `pub focused: bool`

Methods:

- `pub fn new(action_base: u32) -> EditorView`
- `pub fn owns(&self, a: u32) -> bool`
- `pub fn wants_keyboard(&self) -> bool`
- `pub fn load(&mut self, path: &str, text: &str) -> Result<(), String>`: Open `text` as the file `path` (replaces what was there, undo history included). A file that is too big or binary is refused with a sentence.
- `pub fn text(&self) -> String`
- `pub fn dirty(&self) -> bool`
- `pub fn cursor(&self) -> Pos`
- `pub fn error(&self) -> Option<&str>`
- `pub fn reviewing(&self) -> bool`
- `pub fn hunks(&self) -> usize`: The number of changed places waiting for the person's yes or no.
- `pub fn take_save(&mut self) -> Option<(String, String)>`: The person pressed Save: the path and the whole text, once. The app writes it and calls [`EditorView::mark_saved`].
- `pub fn mark_saved(&mut self)`
- `pub fn context(&self) -> EditorContext`: What the assistant should see: the document (at most 40 KB of it, cut at a line) and the selection when there is one. The selection is the person's own text and the document is data, never instructions: the assistant component marks both so.
- `pub fn assistant_context(&self) -> Vec<crate::assistant::ContextItem>`: The same as [`EditorView::context`] as the assistant component's context items (an instruction item that says how to propose a change, the document, the selection), ready for `ChatView::set_context`. The instruction item is what makes a reply readable by [`EditorView::offer_reply`]: the model is told to answer with SEARCH/REPLACE blocks.
- `pub fn offer_reply(&mut self, reply: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, String>`: A reply of the assistant: when it holds SEARCH/REPLACE blocks (or a whole file) that match, they become a proposal to review. Returns the assistant's own explanation (the reply without the blocks), or `Ok(None)` when it holds no edit, or why it cannot be applied.
- `pub fn apply_review(&mut self)`: Apply the accepted hunks as one undoable edit and end the review.
- `pub fn discard_review(&mut self)`
- `pub fn toggle_hunk(&mut self, i: usize)`
- `pub fn action(&mut self, a: u32) -> bool`
- `pub fn key(&mut self, k: UiKey) -> bool`: Keys while the editor has the focus: arrows, Enter, Backspace, Delete, Tab (indent), characters; Esc gives the focus back. Returns whether the key was used.
- `pub fn text_in(&mut self, t: &str) -> bool`: Typed or pasted text (control characters other than a line break are dropped).
- `pub fn wheel(&mut self, d: i32)`
- `pub fn draw(&mut self, c: &mut dyn Canvas, th: &Theme, m: &Metrics, area: Rect)`
